comments.text: A country with no army, an unfenced airport runway that turns into a soccer field when no planes are landing, and massive income from licensing their '.tv' Internet domain (like Twitch.tv)! The existence of Tuvalu feels like a fascinating miracle in the middle of the Pacific. What fact impressed you the most about this tiny 26km2 island nation? 🇹🇻✈
